lines: The festival was something, wasn't it? Rematch anyone you like. They're all a little better now, thanks to you.
Walk in front of someone who wants a duel and they'll spot you. Watch for the "!".
Listen to what they say before you throw. Everyone has a habit.
Not sure where to go? Your stamp card (🎴) always says what's next.
Ah, you must be the new transfer student! Welcome to Knuckle Academy. I'm Mx. Hale, the caretaker.
It's photo day for new students. Let's sort out your name and look first.
Lovely. Now, the one thing you need to know about this school…
Every argument here, from the last lunch roll to the music-room booking, is settled with a Hand Duel.
Hey! You're new too? I'm Rio. First day, and I'm going to be the best duellist this school has ever seen.
First day, first duel. You and me. Right now!
Go on. Throw with your hand on the camera, or use the on-screen buttons.
And listen to what people say before a duel. Everyone has a habit.
Beginner's luck! Next time's mine!
Ha! Told you. Rock beats everything!
Everyone loses their first. Rio told you rock was coming… so what beats rock?
This isn't over. I'm going to get stronger. See you around!
Five clubs run duelling here. Each captain gives a stamp to whoever beats them.
The Stone Club practises in the gym: through the school door, along the corridor. Classmates will challenge you on the way.
Your stamp card (🎴, top right) shows your stamps and where to go next. Good luck!

ch0_intro.goal: Find the Stone Club in the gym (through the school door, along the corridor).

lines: A new face. Stone Club rules: beat my two members, then you may face me.
Cobble and Flint are on the mats. Walk past them.

then.line: Back for more? Stone is patient.

lines: You beat Cobble and Flint. Good.
Stone does not move. Neither do I. And in my club, my shield holds for two hits.
…A crack. Well done.
Take the Stone stamp. And our headband: you'll find it in your locker.

win.goal: Head back to the corridor. Someone's waiting for you.

lines: Solid. Come back when you've seen my habit.
Beat Cobble and Flint first. Then we talk.
A Stone stamp already?! I've been practising. I remember every throw you made at the gate.
Rematch. Now!
How?! I studied you!
…Fine. I'll study harder.
Ha! I knew you'd do that!
Studying people works. Remember that.
The Origami Club's in the library. Bet you can't fold under pressure.

rio_ch1.goal: Find the Origami Club in the library (corridor, middle door).
